import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from h2 import *
T=[]
def add(name, rq, want, gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1', peer='edge', trusted=True):
    T.append((name, [job(rq, gateway=gateway, kind=kind, subject=subject, peer=peer, trusted=trusted)], want, None))
A = acc()
# PAI display names / quotes
add('pai display token', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'Bob <sip:a@x.test>'}), A)
add('pai display quoted', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'"A, B" <sip:a@x.test>'}), A)
add('pai bare tel', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'tel:+15550001'}), A)
add('pai bare sip', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'sip:a@x.test'}), A)
add('pai ws around', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'  <sip:a@x.test>  '}), A)
add('pai empty member', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'<sip:a@x.test>,'}), rj('syntax'))
add('pai empty first', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':',<sip:a@x.test>'}), rj('syntax'))
add('pai three addrs', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'<sip:a@x.test>, <tel:+15550002>, <tel:+15550001>'}), rj('syntax'))
add('pai two headers', req(lines=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:a@x.test>','P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+15550001>']), A)
add('pai two headers 3', req(lines=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:a@x.test>','P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+15550001>, <tel:+15550002>']), rj('syntax'))
add('pai tag param', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'<sip:a@x.test>;tag=x'}), rj('syntax'))
add('pai display semi', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'Bob;tag=x <sip:a@x.test>'}), rj('syntax'))
add('ppi anonymous', req({'P-Preferred-Identity':'<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'}), rj('syntax'))
add('rpid anonymous', req({'Remote-Party-ID':'<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'}), rj('syntax'))
add('pai anonymous second', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'<sip:a@x.test>, <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'}), rj('syntax'))
add('to anonymous', req({'To':'<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'}), A)
add('ruri anonymous', req().replace('sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0','sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid SIP/2.0'), A)
add('from anon display', req({'From':'"Anon" <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t1'}), acc(private=True))
add('from anon no tag', req({'From':'<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'}), acc(private=True))
add('to tel', req({'To':'<tel:+15550002>'}), A)
# unknown ingress kind / gateway
T.append(('unknown kind', [job(req(), kind='other')], rj('unauthenticated'), None))
T.append(('unknown gateway', [job(req(), gateway='nowhere')], rj('unauthenticated'), None))
T.append(('no ingress', [{'gateway':'edge','trusted_out':True,'raw':req()}], rj('unauthenticated'), None))
T.append(('empty jobs', [], None, None))
T.append(('no raw', [{'gateway':'edge','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'s1'},'trusted_out':True}], rj('upstream'), None))
# header-less request
T.append(('no headers', [job(raw([]))], rj('syntax'), None))
T.append(('only rline+blank', [job('MESSAGE sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0\r\n\r\n')], rj('syntax'), None))
T.append(('header no colon', [job(raw(['XBad']))], rj('syntax'), None))
T.append(('empty name colon', [job(raw([': v']))], rj('syntax'), None))
T.append(('name space inside', [job(raw(['X Y: v']))], rj('syntax'), None))
T.append(('empty body', [job(req(body=''))], acc(), None))
T.append(('no crlfcrlf', [job(req()[:-2])], rj('syntax'), None))
T.append(('three crlf', [job(req()+'\r\n')], rj('syntax'), None))
for name, jobs, want, wire in T:
    if want is None:
        res = run(batch(jobs))['results']
        print('%-24s -> %d results %s' % (name, len(res), json.dumps(res)[:120]))
        continue
    got = run(batch(jobs))['results'][0]
    check(name, got, want, wire)
